messages.subject: Not Found page
parts:
Developing an app for use on shiny-server open source..

The app works fine in RStudio (on the same Linux server with the same R installation)

The log shows the app reading in a data file and then simply says Execution Halted.  I tried increasing the timeouts for app start up but to no effect.
I tried changing all the permissions on the files in the server directory -- also no effect.

The file being loaded is large 3.8MB but not overly so.

Here is the log output -- the shinydashboard package is being loaded in the ui.R file so it seems it got through the global.R file that is loading the large file.

messages.author: 22aafb2aa2902d9d
messages.subject: Re: Not Found page
parts:
I just had the exact same issue, and managed to resolve it. Replying to old conversation for the sake of future readers.

In my case the issue was that I had placed a .Rmd file in the main shiny-server directory. When I did that, the .Rmd file would run correctly, but my Shiny apps would only return a webpage stating "Not Found".

The solution was to clean up the main shiny-server directory, removing any unnessary files that could confuse Shiny, and put all .Rmd files in a subdirectory "rmd" (ie /srv/shiny-server/rmd/). With this change, Shiny apps run correctly at my.url/shiny/appname, and Rmarkdown documents run correctly at my.url/shiny/rmd/docname.Rmd

I hope that helps somebody else. This was a really simple issue but took me a long time to figure out as I couldn't see it documented anywhere other than this forum thread.
